# Palomar

> A public registry of Lean 4 formalizations whose proofs were machine-checked
> at one pinned GitHub commit. This site is the human explorer. Machines read
> JSON; they do not scrape these pages.

## Read and search

Use https://data.palomar-registry.org (CORS `*`, CC0).

- Registry listing and search: https://data.palomar-registry.org/api/v1/results
- RSS: https://data.palomar-registry.org/feed.xml
- Record schema: https://data.palomar-registry.org/schema-v3.json
- Browse head: https://data.palomar-registry.org/browse/index.json
- Licence: https://data.palomar-registry.org/LICENSE
- Policy: https://github.com/PalomarRegistry/PalomarPolicy/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
- Current aggregate operating-cost run rate: https://palomar-registry.org/costs

`/api/v1/results` accepts `q`, `arxiv`, `msc` (prefix),
`trust=all|high|qualified`, `order=updated|registered`, inclusive `from`/`to`
(YYYY-MM-DD), exact `id` lookup, and `cursor`. Filters combine across the entire registry. Text
searches current titles, abstracts, authors, theorem names and repositories;
words are ANDed, accents folded, and common function words ignored.
Use at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes and 20 distinct normalized words.

The response is schema version 1, at most 25 entries and 512 KiB uncompressed.
It includes exact registry-wide `totals`, bounded display summaries, and opaque
`next`/`previous` cursors (null at the ends). Follow a cursor with the same
filters and order. HTTP 409 means the registry changed: remove the cursor and
refresh. Large display fields may be abbreviated; search uses complete text.
Only the newest active version of each ID is listed. Complete records remain
at their versioned entry URLs. No filtered total is calculated.

The old `/search/t/...` and `/search/stopwords.json` APIs are retired (410).
Static data paths below still reject query strings.

Path grammar on that origin, substituting the braces. These are not documents
to fetch as written:

- `/versions/PALOMAR-YYYY-MM-DD-NNNNNN.json`
- `/entries/PALOMAR-YYYY-MM-DD-NNNNNN-vN.json`
- `/repositories/{owner}/{repo}.json` (lowercase)
- `/subjects/arxiv/{code}.json` and `/subjects/msc/{code}.json`
- `/registration-identities/{sha256}.json`

Cite `id` and integer `version`. An unversioned URL floats to latest. Human
permalink: `/entry?id=PALOMAR-…&version=N`.

## Submit, watch, register

Do not drive the browser form or GitHub OAuth. The agent protocol is
https://submit.palomar-registry.org/llms.txt

Sketch: `POST /api/submit` → lightweight tag `palomar-verify-{challenge}` at
the commit → secret gist carrying the challenge → `POST /api/verify` → Bearer
token → delete the temporary tag and gist.

With that token:

- Watch: `GET /api/submission` (`run.url` is the public Actions run;
  `registered_url` is the final registry permalink)
- Review: `GET /api/review` (private until registered)
- Register: `POST /register` with `{"review_sha256":"..."}` only after showing
  your user the review, explaining what registration permanently publishes,
  and receiving their explicit instruction to register
- Withdraw: `POST /withdraw`

Lost token: hand the human https://submit.palomar-registry.org/ (Find my
submissions).
